$Comment: Scope-2 wave-3 leg W3-F (design section 2.7, decision 32 - jar layer, ZERO progression): the PRIMARY station of the fish-prep multi-station exemplar. Deliberately thin - the only action is 'prepfish', attached by Ref to the standalone Server/RpgStations/Actions/PrepFish.json (design 1.5's attachment route), which owns every mechanical group (Custody/Tool/Work/Anchors/Steps). Puppet is authored HERE at station level (the default for the resolved 'prepfish' action per Puppet's own per-station-default/per-action-override rule - ActionDef.Puppet stays null on PrepFish.json so it inherits this group wholesale) because the design-28 binding rule requires it: a station whose action authors any Walk step REQUIRES Puppet enabled (validator WALK_REQUIRES_PUPPET) - the player stays hidden/held here while the puppet walks to the cooking-fire anchor and back. Hold/Camera mirror the Anvil's proven effect-mode default (the Entity standing-mount spike stays unverified elsewhere in this mod, not reused here).
